description: Source code for IPv4 network configuration and management commands within Zephyr RTOS, including interface address management, IPv4 support status, and address lifetime reporting.

methods.name: ip_address_lifetime_cb
methods.description: Callback function to print IPv4 address information for each network interface.

methods.name: cmd_net_ipv4
methods.description: Displays IPv4 support status and network interface information.

methods.name: cmd_net_ip_add
methods.description: Adds an IPv4 address to a specified network interface.

methods.name: cmd_net_ip_del
methods.description: Removes an IPv4 address from a specified network interface.
